paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks

annotations.annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of outcomes for errors with GPT-4, totaling seven categories. The slices are labeled as Incorrect (blue, 43.6%), Correct (red, 31.6%), Partial (yellow, 11.3%), Unknown (orange, 8.3%), Syntax Error (green, 2.3%), Bad Response (light blue, 1.5%), and an unlabeled category in teal. Each segment is accompanied by its respective percentage, aside from the unlabeled category. The chart does not include a legend on the right side, with percentage labels outside the slices. The chart's segments are not ordered by size.
